entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Court made the following order:
This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, seeking the indulgence of the Court with the following prayer:
"......to issue an appropriate writ, order, orders or directions more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of Respondent No 3 in not conducting the investigation and not making any efforts to file the charge sheet as per law in Crime No 6 of 2024 dated 12 01 2024 registered at Disha UPS Vizianagaram Vizianagaram District even after lapse of 10 months as illegal arbitrary and violation of Article 14 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the Respondents to conduct and complete the investigation as per law forthwith in connection with Crime No 6 of 2024 dated 12 01 2024 registered U/s 498A 506 IPC 3 4 DPA on the file of Disha UPS Vizianagaram Vizianagaram District and to pass".
2. Heard Sri Jada Sravan Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.
3. The grievance of the Petitioner is that the police are not filing charge sheet in the case.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, on written instructions would submit that after due investigation police filed charge sheet on 21.03.2024 vide C.C.No.309 of 2024 on the file of learned Judicial First Class Magistrate (Special Mobile Court), Vizianagaram, for the offences punishable under Sections 498 and 506 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961.
